summary: Added validation in load() to check that each item in the JSON array is a dict before passing it to Todo.from_dict(). This prevents confusing TypeError when the JSON contains non-dict items.
approach: Minimal defensive validation - enumerate through items and raise ValueError with clear message identifying the invalid index before attempting to process with Todo.from_dict()
risks: None - this is a pure validation addition that catches an edge case earlier with a better error message
acceptance_criteria_met: load() raises ValueError (not TypeError) when JSON array contains non-dict items
Error message clearly indicates which item in the array is invalid (includes index and type)
